tracking: ADR-0365 (lane E46, slice 1): the live context graph is API-only in the lane brief; its admin bindings screen and the member graph view are requested on #453. raised under the lane brief (new routes go to the census with a KNOWN_UI_GAPS entry on #453; recorded in ADR-0365)

gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/sources: lists the PM connections bound into the context graph, each with the project whose members may read it and when it last synced
gaps.POST /v1/context-graph/sources: binds a PM connection to a project (a settings_relax step-up, audited), letting that project's members read its work-item linkage
gaps.PATCH /v1/context-graph/sources/:sourceI: rebinds a source to another project (same step-up, audited); its nodes are re-scoped in the same transaction
gaps.DELETE /v1/context-graph/sources/:source: unbinds a source (audited), removing its nodes, edges and scopes
gaps.POST /v1/context-graph/sources/:sourceId: runs an incremental (or full) sync of the source's imported work items into the graph, audited
gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/nodes: lists the graph nodes the caller may read (filtered by their own project memberships)
gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/nodes/:nodeId: reads one node the caller may read (404 otherwise)
gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/nodes/:nodeId/neig: reads a node's neighbourhood (1 or 2 hops) over readable nodes and edges only
